title: Positively 4th Street
original_lyrics:
[verse]
You got lotta nerve to say you are my friend
When I was down you just stood there grinning
You got lotta nerve to say you got helping hand
You just want to be on the side that's winning
You say I let you down you know it's not like that
If you're so hurt why then don't you show it
You say you lost your faith but that's not where it's at
You had no faith to lose and you know it
I know the reason that you talk behind my back
I used to be among the crowd you're in with
Do you take me for such fool to think I' make contact
With the one who tries to hide what he don't know to begin with
You see me on the street you always act surprised
You say, "How are you?" "Good luck" but you don't mean it
When you know as well as me you' rather see me paralyzed
Why don't you just come out once and scream it
No, I do not feel that good when I see the heartbreaks you embrace
If I was master thief perhaps I' rob them
And now I know you're dissatisfied with your position and your place
Don't you understand it's not my problem
I wish that for just one time you could stand inside my shoes
And just for that one moment I could be you
Yes, I wish that for just one time you could stand inside my shoes
You' know what drag it is to see you

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
You got lotta nerve to say you are my friend
When I was down you just stood there grinning
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You're mad at someone for pretending to be a friend when they weren't helpful when you were down.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
You got lotta nerve to say you got helping hand
You just want to be on the side that's winning
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You're mad because they only pretend to help to look good.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
You say I let you down
you know it's not like that
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: They are accusing you of something you didn't do.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
If you're so hurt why then don't you show it
You say you lost your faith
but that's not where it's at
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You're calling them out for not showing their true feelings and for lying about their faith.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
You had no faith to lose and you know it
I know the reason that you talk behind my back
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You know they never had faith to begin with, and you know they talk about you behind your back.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
I used to be among the crowd you're in with
Do you take me for such fool to think I' make contact
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You used to be part of their group, and you're asking if they think you're stupid enough to want to be friends again.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
With the one who tries to hide
what he don't know to begin with
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You're talking about someone who pretends to know things they don't.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
You see me on the street you always act surprised
You say
"How are you?" "Good luck" but you don't mean it
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: They act surprised to see you and say nice things, but you know they don't mean it.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric: When you know as well as me you' rather see me paralyzed
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You know they'd rather see you fail.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
Why don't you just come
out once and scream it
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You wish they would just admit how they really feel.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric: I do not feel that good when I see the heartbreaks you embrace
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You don't feel good seeing the bad things they go through.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric: If I was master thief perhaps I' rob them
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You're sarcastically saying you'd steal their problems if you could.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric: And now I know you're dissatisfied with your position and your place
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You know they are unhappy with their life.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric: Don't you understand it's not my problem
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You're saying their problems aren't your concern.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
I wish that for just one time you could stand inside my shoes
And just for that one moment I could be you
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You wish they could understand your perspective.

line_by_line_plot.original_lyric:
I wish that for just one time you could stand inside my shoes
You' know what drag it is to see you
line_by_line_plot.eli5_simplification: You repeat the wish for them to understand, and express the frustration of seeing them.
